obligations.explanation: Ending home has an abstract route.
Every reachable nonterminal state has an ending route under the named assumptions.
Exactly one ending may match a terminal state.
No entry fees, scarce ammunition or random essential drops. Attempt health refills, failures preserve permanent resources, rewards are unique once-only tokens.
Challenge gate_trial needs a reachable entry with conditions [{'ability': 'field_dodge'}].
Guaranteed once-only reward for gate_trial: {'abilities': [], 'items': ['trail_key']} is available after assumed success.
Failure must return to a safe checkpoint with a route back to start gate_trial; no completion event may be needed to escape the retry.
Challenge relay_trial needs a reachable entry with conditions [].
Guaranteed once-only reward for relay_trial: {'abilities': [], 'items': []} is available after assumed success.
Failure must return to a safe checkpoint with a route back to start relay_trial; no completion event may be needed to escape the retry.
Ability field_dodge must have a reachable producer or initial grant.
Region arena must be reachable through its finite gates.
Region field must be reachable through its finite gates.
Region hub must be reachable through its finite gates.
Gate move:arena:to_hub must be usable; required conditions: []
Gate move:field:to_hub must be usable; required conditions: []
Gate move:hub:to_arena must be usable; required conditions: [{'ability': 'field_dodge'}]
Gate move:hub:to_field must be usable; required conditions: [{'item': 'trail_key', 'present': True}]
Course relay_course requires at least 218 ticks by the minimum distance/speed metric; deadline is 1200. Passing this bound does not establish steering feasibility.
Inherited collectible identity, threshold and non-missability obligations must all hold.
Project policy must explicitly permit conditional challenge completion; it cannot be silently upgraded to proof.

reason: Complete finite graph; skill outcomes are hypothetical, not executable player choices.
